oṭṭha: [vasa + ta. ] (pu, na) CL=7 [Usa + ta. Dhāna, ṭī. 502. Uḍra(saṃ)] A camel.

[usa + ta. ] (pu, na) CL=7 [Usa + ṭṭha. Dhāna, ṭī. 262. Usa + ṭha. Odanādīsu uṇhena u-sīyatīti oṭṭho. Moga,7.55. Ava+dhā+ta. Dante odahanti pidahantīti oṭṭhā. Madhu,1.52.otṭha (saṃ)] (A) Lips. Mouth. (B) The lip of (a monk bowl, pot, cup, etc.,). The face. The mouth of the surface (of a pot, etc.,).
oṭṭhabhaujana: [oṭṭha + bhaujana] (na) CL=7 Moving to winkle the lip.
oṭṭhacalana: [oṭṭha + calana] (thī, na) CL=7 Moves or shakes the lips.
oṭṭhacammasaṇṭhāna: [oṭṭhacamma + saṇṭhāna]  CL=9 The shape of the skin of lip.
oṭṭhachinna: [oṭṭha + chinna] (ti) CL=7 One who has a broken lip.
oṭṭhachinnaka: [oṭṭha + chinna + ka] (ti) CL=7 One who has a broken lip.
oṭṭhaddha: [oṭṭha + addha] (ti) CL=7 One who is named Oṭṭhaddha with a half lip.
oṭṭhadvaya: [oṭṭha + dvaya] (na) CL=7 A set of two lips. A set of lips.
oṭṭhadvayasamannāgata: [oṭṭhadvaya + samannāgata] (ti) CL=7 A set of two lips. Completed with two lips.
oṭṭhagīvāsaṇṭhāna: [oṭṭhagīvā + saṇṭhāna] (pu, na) CL=7 The appearance is like the neck of a camel.
oṭṭhagīvī: [oṭṭhagīvā + ī] (ti) CL=7 Like the neck of a camel.
oṭṭhaja: [oṭṭha + jana + kvi] (ti) CL=7 Labial (letter) or bilabial.
oṭṭhamaṃsa: [oṭṭha + maṃsa] (na) CL=7 Lip"s flesh or the flesh of lips.
oṭṭhamaṃsamakkhana: [oṭṭhamaṃsa + makkhana] (ti) CL=7 (Saliva, etc.,) that wets or smears on the lips. See - Oṭṭhamaṃsasammakkhanakheḷa.
oṭṭhamaṃsasammakkhana: [oṭṭhamaṃsa + sammakkhana] (ti) CL=7 Smeared on the lips. See below.
oṭṭhamaṃsasammakkhitakheḷa: [oṭṭhamaṃsasammakkhita + kheḷa] (pu) CL=7 Saliva that smears or wets on the lips.
oṭṭhamaṃsasampakkhanakheḷa: [oṭṭhamaṃsasammakkhana + kheḷa] (pu) CL=7 (Saliva, etc.,) that wets or smears on the lips.
oṭṭhamukha: [oṭṭhamukha + mukha. ] (ti) CL=7 [Oṭṭha+mukha. Oṭṭhamukhamiva mukhaṃ yassa so oṭṭhamukho. Muddhabodha,ṭī. Oṭṭhova mukhamassāti viggayha oṭṭhamukhoti samāso. Maucikā, ṭī. Moga, sya, 1. 439-440.] One whose face is like a camel"s face.
oṭṭhanibbhoga: [oṭṭha + nibbhoga] (pu) CL=7 Moves and makes wrinkled lips.
oṭṭhanillehaka: [oṭṭha + nillehaka] (ti) CL=7 One who licks lips (with tongue). (kri, vi). To lick lips.
oṭṭhapahata: [oṭṭhapahata (ṭa) + karaṇa] (ṭa) karaṇa (na) CL=7 Showing moving of lips. (saddattha.). Chanting. (adhippāyattha.).
oṭṭhaparivattana: [oṭṭha + parivattana] (na) CL=7 Moving lips. (saddattha.)  Chanting. (adhippāyattha.) See below.
oṭṭhapariyosāna: [oṭṭha + pariyosāna] (ti) CL=7 The boundary that is the lip or the boundary of the lip.
oṭṭhapenti: [ava + ṭhāna + kāpe + anti] (kā, kri) CL=7 (They) cause to place at below. (They) put down, They oppress. They suppress. See - Omaddanti.
oṭṭhaphusanarahitavimuttabyaujana: [oṭṭhaphusanarahitavimutta + byaujana] (na) CL=7 The vowel that is without touching lips.
oṭṭharatha: [oṭṭha + ratha] (pu) CL=7 A coach that is pulled by a camel.
oṭṭhattaca: [oṭṭha + taca] (pu) CL=7 The skin of the lips. Lip skin.
oṭṭhavacittaka: [(uṭṭha + citta= oṭṭhava citta + kā + a. ] (pu) CL=7 [Oṭṭhava + citta + ka] A bird that sings as 'Uṭṭhehi citta, uṭṭhehi citta'. A bird is named Oṭṭhavicittaka.
oṭṭhavadanādivippakāra: [oṭṭhavadanādi + vippakāra] (pu)  CL=7 The bad manner that is blaming such as 'a camel'. A bad manner of the mouth or lips by moving the mouth (such as blaming or insulting). (bhāsā,ṭī.).
oṭṭhavaṭṭi: [oṭṭha + vaṭṭi] (thī) CL=7 The line of the lip of (a monk bowl, pot, cup, etc.,). The line of the mouth. The line of the surface.
oṭṭhaṭṭhivaṇtha: [oṭṭha + aṭṭhivaṇṇa. ] (ti) CL=7 [Oṭṭhaṭṭhi + vaṇṇa] The appearance is like the bone of a camel.
oṭṭhibyādhi: [yādicchakanāma] (thī) CL=7 A female elephant (is named) Oṭṭhibyādhi.
oṭṭhubhanti: [ava + ṭhubha + a + anti] (ti) CL=7 They spit on. See - Oṭṭhubhati.
oṭṭhubhati: [ava + ṭhubha + a + ti. ] (kri) CL=7 [Avatṭhivati (saṃ)] Spits on.
oṭṭhubheyya: [ava + ṭhubha + eyya] (kri) CL=7 He should spit. See - Oṭṭhubhati.
oṭṭhādho: [oṭṭha + adho] (pu) CL=7 One whose lip is hanging down.
oṭṭhamasa: [oṭṭha + maṃsa] (na) CL=7 Lip"s flesh or the flesh of lips.
oṭṭhamasamakkhana: [oṭṭhamaṃsa + makkhana] (ti) CL=7 (Saliva, etc.,) that wets or smears on the lips. See - Oṭṭhamaṃsasammakkhanakheḷa.
oṭṭhamasasammakkhana: [oṭṭhamaṃsa + sammakkhana] (ti) CL=7 Smeared on the lips. See below.
oṭṭhamasasammakkhitakheḷa: [oṭṭhamaṃsasammakkhita + kheḷa] (pu) CL=7 Saliva that smears or wets on the lips.
oṭṭhamasasampakkhanakheḷa: [oṭṭhamaṃsasammakkhana + kheḷa] (pu) CL=7 (Saliva, etc.,) that wets or smears on the lips.
